theron02.c01.keys: "A key is missing from your board. The Gate's. Where is it?"
theron02.c01.keys.locked: You haven't looked at the key board.
theron02.d_keys: On my belt. Always on my belt. ...Who told you to look at my board?
theron03.c01.sanctuary: "I already know about the shrine of Hestia at the port. That's worth double."
theron03.d_sanctuary: So someone has already talked to you. Good: half the work is done, and I'll pay double for the other half.
theron03.c02.mosaic: "Who tore the Fate with the shears out of your floor?"
theron03.c02.smell: "The urn is cold and smells of burnt thread. Those aren't a person's ashes."
theron03.d_mosaic: I had it torn out. Whoever pays not to be cut doesn't leave the shears in sight. There are those who pay more than I do, Théron. Much higher up.
theron03.d_smell: ...Good nose. No, they aren't a person's ashes. It's what remains when a thread is cut that should never have been cut. Keep it sealed.
theron04.t_urn_smell: Not a person's ashes, Caio said. What remains of a thread that should never have been cut. And I am carrying it under the flame.
theron04.h.net.2: He works a scrap loose from the net, a square with her stitch, folds it and tucks it in his belt.
theron04.c_last.net: Sit beside her with the scrap of net in his lap, like a customer who brought work.
theron04.c_last.net.locked: You brought nothing that would make her look like just a mender with a customer.
theron04.d_net: He sits and spreads the scrap. Nerea understands before she looks: she takes the needle, pulls the thread, and the two of them mend as if they had always done it.
theron04.d_net2: A mender and a customer. Where is the woman who says the name?
theron04.d_net3: Only nets here, sir. And customers who don't pay.
theron04.t_seal: The seal at his belt. It's the scribe from the market. He doesn't remember me, but he wrote down her name.
theron04.bark.nerea_warned: A priestess came by last night, fire in her hands. She said they were coming for me. I stayed. Someone has to mend.
livia03.c03.warm: Put Domícia's hand on the warm stone by the column.
livia03.d_warm: Lívia guides Domícia's hand to the crack by the column. Domícia pulls it back as if burned. She stares at her palm for a while.
livia03.d_warm2: Still warm. After so many years. ...Don't go down, Lívia. I know what is down there, and that's why I'm asking.
livia04.d24b: You put my hand on that stone. I know what the flame burned, and what it keeps warm down there. One day I'll tell you. Not today.
livia04.h.augur_tablet.1: Forgotten on a bench, the augur's wax tablet. A new line, from today: "Port. The net woman who says the scraped name. Fetch her tomorrow night."
livia04.dp6b: Tomorrow night the College is coming for a net woman, here at the port. The one who says a name no one says. If you know anyone like that...
theron04.d_sloppy_wary: The cup hands... at my belt. The key! Thief! ...No one on the quay looks. No one ever looks at you, do they?
theron04.d_bribe_hurt: Silver? ...I'll take it. Since the galleries I limp, and a guard who limps doesn't rise. Go on. I saw nothing down there, and I see nothing here.
theron04.d_taken_net: A mender... with a stitch too tight for one who only mends. It's you. It's written here.
theron03.d_pose3b: You already touched it. I saw. Don't touch it again before it's time.
